discovery_lead.lead: Chickasha industrial park power station (gas supply)
discovery_lead.what_discovery_found: Southwest Ledger, June 2025: Energy Transfer will connect the planned Citizen Capital and Lightfield Energy gas plant, which is meant to power a data center at the Chickasha Airport Industrial Park, to one of two high-pressure gas lines near the airport. No new pipeline, length or route is stated. Energy Transfer owns Enable Gas Transmission (P0161), the likeliest line. Its Enable Oklahoma Intrastate Transmission system (P0163) is the other possibility, and the article does not say which. The plant is still only announced. Treat this as a data center lead on the existing row, not a new pipeline. No other name to add.

evidence.note: Southwest Ledger, June 10, 2025.
